makefun 0.1.0: the make.fun command line

usage:
  makefun record --competition <slug> [--source <repo dir>] [--api-key <key>] [--origin <url>]
                 [--claude-dir <dir>... | --no-claude] [--codex-dir <dir>... | --no-codex]
                 [--<harness>-dir <dir>...] [--<harness>] [--no-<harness>] [--muse-usage <file>]
                 [-- <command> [args...]]
  makefun record --finish <id> [--muse-usage <file>] [--api-key <key>] [--origin <url>]
      A strict-transcripts competition (its requirements' how_to_submit.strict_transcripts) takes no
      transcript upload: start this in the background before your agent writes any code, with
      --source naming the repository (without it, run from inside the kit, record watches the kit's
      directory), then start your agent's session and build there (a session begun before the
      recording started fails transcripts_witnessed), and stop it when the build is done:
        mkdir -p ~/.makefun; makefun record --competition <slug> --source <repo dir> > ~/.makefun/record-<slug>.log 2>&1 & echo $! > ~/.makefun/record-<slug>.pid
        kill "$(cat ~/.makefun/record-<slug>.pid)"
      Or wrap one new headless agent session, which record runs in the repository and records from its
      first line until it exits, for example:
        -- claude -p "<task>" --permission-mode acceptEdits --allowedTools Bash
=== check ===
makefun 0.1.0: the make.fun command line

usage:
  makefun check [--kit <dir>] [--repo <dir>] [--commit <sha>] [--worktree]
                 [--play-code <n>] [--api-key <key>] [--origin <url>]
                 [--dotenv <path>] [--transcripts <bundle.tar.gz | file | dir>] [--json]
      Run the site's own pre-submit checks here, with no network but play_link's (below), on a
      repository's commit (default HEAD; --worktree: the files as they are) and the transcripts
      you will upload with it (the
      bundle, one loose transcript file, or a directory of them), against the kit's competition:
      the competition open now, the intake's size caps, a root LICENSE declaring an OSI-approved
      SPDX-License-Identifier, the entrypoint the competition's runtimes name, a source bundle
      entry's drand anchor (repo_created_after_open), the entry's own size caps where the
      competition's harness names them (entry_size), on an agent/v1 competition the committed-key
